title: H1 killed: no 0DTE condor premium after costs
detail: 171 condors, 176 in-sample days: net -12.0% to -12.2% at put skew 0.10/0.20/0.30, PF 0.39-0.42, win rate 68-70% (below the 80% that a zero-edge book shows in synthetic markets, so realized moves exceeded priced moves), worst day -0.85%, CVaR(95) -0.82%, max DD 12.3%. Costs are about $48 of the ~$69 average daily loss, but the book loses before costs too. Diagnostic with raw VIX1D (atmScale 1.0): still -2.4% to -2.9%, PF 0.79. Kill criterion met: mid-skew net <= 0, sign does not depend on skew.
